queries.prompt: This memo documents version 2 of the OSPF protocol. OSPF is
queries.expected_continuation: a link-state routing protocol. It is designed to be run internal to a single Autonomous System.

queries.prompt: Even with larger IPv6 addresses, most packets in OSPF for IPv6 are
queries.expected_continuation: almost as compact as those in OSPF for IPv4.

queries.prompt: NSSAs are similar to the existing OSPF stub area configuration option but have the additional capability of
queries.expected_continuation: importing AS external routes in a limited fashion.

queries.prompt: A restarting router may not be capable of adjusting its forwarding in a timely manner when
Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) [RFC5880] enables routers to
queries.expected_continuation: monitor data plane connectivity and to detect faults in the bidirectional path between them.

queries.prompt: For organizations managing on-premises data centers, the Cisco Nexus Dashboard serves as
queries.expected_continuation: the single point of control for provisioning, visibility, troubleshooting, and automation.

queries.prompt: Cisco® data center networking with Cisco Nexus® 9000 Series Switches and the Nexus Dashboard operations and automation platform provides
queries.expected_continuation: the interplay of cutting-edge silicon, hardware, software, optics, and management tools to deliver high bandwidth, lossless, and low latency AI/ML networks.

queries.prompt: Virtual Extensible LAN (VXLAN) provides a way to extend Layer 2 networks across
queries.expected_continuation: a Layer 3 infrastructure using MAC-in-UDP encapsulation and tunneling.
queries.source_document: Cisco Nexus 9000 NX-OS VXLAN Configuration Guide

queries.prompt: This document describes common Virtual Port Channel (vPC) enhancements configured on
queries.expected_continuation: Cisco Nexus switches in a vPC domain.

queries.prompt: Cisco Nexus 9000 series switches use cut-through switching by default. Cut-through switching is where a switch
queries.expected_continuation: makes a forwarding decision on a frame and begins forwarding the frame out of an egress interface as soon as the switch has processed enough of the frame header to make a valid forwarding decision.
